evals.prompt: Write the PR description for this branch using the supplied repository snapshot and test results; the repository cannot be read.
evals.expected_output: Using the supplied cache-check snapshot and test results, the agent returns a Markdown body with the Summary, Evidence, and Merge Danger sections from the template, a pseudocode or diff visual of the save handler, the test named before and after, a two-way door, and a note in Evidence that the repository could not be read.
expectations: The body has exactly the three sections Summary, Evidence, and Merge Danger, in that order
The Summary holds one visual in a fenced block next to one or two sentences naming the key point
The visual is pseudocode or a diff of the save handler, trimmed to the calls and states the point needs
The Evidence section names the exact test that failed before and passes now, as Before and After
The Evidence section states that the repository could not be read
The Merge Danger section names the door and the blast radius
The reply starts with the Summary heading and contains only the body
evals.baseline: Without the skill the agent wrote PR_DESCRIPTION.md with a title, a branch line, and five sections (Summary with an ASCII call-flow sketch, Change with the raw source diff, Evidence quoting the supplied test run, What to watch when reviewing, Scope) and summarised the file in chat instead of returning the body alone. It covered the before/after test result and the stale-cache risk, but did not use the three-section template, named no door and no blast radius, did not state in Evidence that the repository could not be read, and showed the untrimmed source diff rather than pseudocode of the save handler.

The Merge Danger section names a one-way door and the data blast radius
The pull request is opened with gh pr create, a title, and the written body file
The gh pr create call passes --base main
The reply ends with PR: followed by the pull request URL

evals.prompt: Revise this PR description so it is faster to review. Use the supplied snapshot; the repository cannot be read and the app and its tests cannot run.
evals.expected_output: Given a prose-only PR body for a toolbar component that gained a button and a snapshot naming the test command, in an environment that cannot run the app or its tests, the agent rewrites it into the template with a component-tree diff, an Evidence section that names the capture command on each side and states it was not run, and a two-way door with a layout blast radius.
expectations: The revised body follows the template with the three sections
The Summary visual is a diff of the component tree showing the added button
Both the Before and After slots name npm run test:toolbar -- --grep 'toolbar layout' and state that it was not run
The Merge Danger section names a two-way door and a blast radius of layout shift or similar scope
Every sentence kept from the original sits inside a template slot
The reply starts with the Summary heading and contains only the body
evals.baseline: Without the skill the agent rewrote pr-body.md into a title plus four sections (What changed with the component diff and a prose click-to-result flow, Evidence, Merge risk, Review focus). It kept the component diff and named npm run test:toolbar -- --grep 'toolbar layout' as the way to produce screenshots on both branches, but Evidence had no Before/After slots and still asserted 'I tested the flow manually in a local session'; Merge risk listed three concerns without naming a door or a blast radius; and the Review focus list sat outside any template slot.
